scenarios.issue_statement: Investigate orphan openclaw-completion process accumulation, identify the most likely cleanup or lifecycle boundary responsible for the leak, propose a minimal fix or guard, define a focused regression validation path, and have a reviewer verify the patch targets the right boundary.

planner.context_text: Start with background-process.md and recover-orphaned-processes.sh, then inspect entry.ts and node-host/invoke.ts. Avoid rediscovery.

executor.context_text: Use the planner handoff. Stay on entry.ts and node-host/invoke.ts. Validate with recover-orphaned-processes.sh or stale-pid paths only.

reviewer.context_text: Review only whether the fix targets the cleanup boundary and whether validation is focused.

planner.prompt: You are the planner. Localize the leak boundary, identify the smallest set of target files, and hand off a concise investigation plan to the executor.

toolset.name: repo-grep-broad
toolset.description: Broad repo-wide search across docs, scripts, src, and tests.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "openclaw-completion|orphan|background process|child-process bridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|spawn\(" docs scripts src test | sed -n '1,140p'

toolset.name: read-background-doc
toolset.description: Read the background process doc that describes child-process bridge expectations.

toolset.name: read-recovery-script
toolset.description: Read the orphan recovery script to see how the repo currently diagnoses the problem.

toolset.name: read-entry
toolset.description: Read the CLI entry respawn path where a child-process bridge is attached.

toolset.name: read-node-invoke
toolset.description: Read the node-host invoke path where spawned processes are managed.

executor.prompt: You are the executor. Use the planner output to propose the smallest viable fix or guard and a focused validation path. Do not invent broad test sweeps unless the repo evidence forces you to.

toolset.name: source-grep-broad
toolset.description: Broad scan for process lifecycle and signal handling paths across the codebase.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|spawn\(|recover-orphaned-processes|background process" src scripts docs | sed -n '1,160p'

toolset.name: read-node-invoke
toolset.description: Read the node-host invoke path where subprocess lifecycle may leak.

toolset.name: read-entry
toolset.description: Read the CLI entry wrapper and child-process bridge attachment.

toolset.name: read-recovery-script
toolset.description: Read the orphan recovery script for expected failure shape and naming.

toolset.name: read-restart-stale-test
toolset.description: Read the stale pid tests for a focused validation direction.

toolset.name: validate-broad
toolset.description: Broad validation scan over signals and process cleanup references.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "SIGTERM|SIGKILL|attachChildProcessBridge|orphan|background process" docs/gateway/background-process.md scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'

toolset.name: focused-signal-scan
toolset.description: Focused validation scan over the likely cleanup boundary and stale pid helpers.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|orphan" src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,200p'

reviewer.prompt: You are the reviewer. Decide whether the executor's proposed fix really targets the right cleanup boundary and whether the validation path is focused and credible.

toolset.name: read-planner-artifact
toolset.description: Read the saved planner handoff artifact.

toolset.name: read-executor-artifact
toolset.description: Read the saved executor output artifact.

toolset.name: focused-signal-scan
toolset.description: Read the focused boundary scan covering child-process bridge and stale pid cleanup references.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "attachChildProcessBridge|SIGTERM|SIGKILL|orphan" src/entry.ts src/node-host/invoke.ts scripts/recover-orphaned-processes.sh src/infra/restart-stale-pids.ts src/infra/restart-stale-pids.test.ts | sed -n '1,200p'
